tools.name: Codex native
tools.pin: OpenAI Google Drive app, also used by ChatGPT · 2026-10-05 (definitions + probes)

purposes.label: Read
purposes.outcome: Return the requested content and properties with their relationships intact; identify missing information.

purposes.label: Select
purposes.outcome: Identify the intended item using document concepts and distinguish multiple candidates.

purposes.label: Change wording
purposes.outcome: Change the requested characters while retaining structural roles, unaffected formatting, links, references and other work.

purposes.label: Change formatting
purposes.outcome: Change only the requested properties on the selected items.

purposes.label: Create
purposes.outcome: Produce the requested item with native behavior, in the requested location.

purposes.label: Restructure
purposes.outcome: Move, split, join, nest, reorder, insert or delete structure while retaining content and relationships outside the change.

purposes.label: Preserve
purposes.outcome: Retain content, properties and relationships of items outside the requested change.

purposes.label: Publish Markdown
purposes.outcome: Create a document from Markdown with native headings, lists, tables, links, code, quotes, images, footnotes and tabs.

purposes.label: Update from Markdown
purposes.outcome: Apply local Markdown changes while retaining direct edits, review items and objects absent from the source.

purposes.label: Suggest
purposes.outcome: Leave a pending reviewable suggestion; inspect, accept or reject suggestions.

purposes.label: Discuss
purposes.outcome: Read, create, reply to, resolve, reopen or delete comment threads attached to content or the whole document.

purposes.label: Manage files and access
purposes.outcome: Find, copy, rename, move, organize, export and share documents with the intended audience and role.
